_note: Cinyanja Grade 1 Teacher's Guide — first typeset. The manuscript is body-only: it ships no cover block, no imprint/ISBN page, no author (MLEMBI) page, foreword, preface or contents list, so the engine has nothing to build front matter from. That is an author/publisher gap, not something to invent here — see the handover notes.
_note_termPages: 'TEMU 1' = TERM 1 (the school-term banner), not a unit heading — the engine's own termPages/termpage handling documents the same reading. Left as a bare paragraph it printed as three stray bold lines at the top of page 1; as a term page it opens the body properly.
_note_insertHead: The author's Unit 9 banner is simply missing. Every other unit reads 'UNIT n' immediately above 'GAWO LOYAMBA: KUMVETSELA NDI KULANKHULA'; at Unit 9 that line is absent, so Unit 9's content was being absorbed into Unit 8 and the book showed 11 banners for 12 units. Anchored on the sub-topic that opens Unit 9 ('1.4.1 KUCITA SEWELO'), which occurs exactly once. Kept in the author's own 'UNIT n' wording, and inserted as an h1 (the unit-banner block type) because the banner promotion runs BEFORE overrides are applied — a default bold head came out as a plain line mid-page instead of the banner its eleven siblings get.
_note_cover: House-style cover (HOUSE-STYLE.md 3): centred masthead - eyebrow / big subject / accent rule / grade tag / book type / hero photo / authors / ZEPH logo, in the nyanja theme colour. The manuscript ships no cover page, so the hero photo is supplied here. Source art was 1066x1280 (154 DPI at B5 width, under the 300 DPI print floor); upscaled 4x with Real-ESRGAN (realesrgan-x4plus, -t 128) to 4264x5120 = 615 DPI at full B5 width, and stored as PNG rather than JPEG so the print master carries no compression artefacts.
_note_booktype: The cover book-type line is synthesised in English ("Teacher's Guide"); this is the Cinyanja form from the engine's own nyanja word list (terms.teachers_guide), matching how the Kikaonde sibling reads BUUKU WA MUFUNJISHI rather than English.
_note_covertext: Cover masthead in the book's own spelling: the theme subject is spelt "Chinyanja", but this manuscript titles itself CINYANJA on its very first line, so the cover follows the book. The grade word is NOT overridden here — `grade` is book metadata, not a cover label: setting it to the Cinyanja "GIREDI 1" also re-files the build under output/Giredi 1/. Localising the grade word on local-language covers (the Kikaonde sibling reads GILEDI 1) is an engine job, not a per-book hack.
subject: CINYANJA
_note_remove: The manuscript opens with its own informal two-line title block. With a real cover and title page now built (house-style front-matter order: cover then repeated title page), those two lines were left stranded on a page of their own between the title page and the TEMU 1 term page, saying a third time what the two pages before them already say. Both strings occur exactly once in the manuscript.
